# rzlabs

> rzlabs is a small code & motion studio run by Fábio: AI products and software, websites, motion design and animation. One human, supervised by three cats (Blue, Spooky and Zoe).

Website: https://rzlabs.me
Contact: hello@rzlabs.me (or the brief form at https://rzlabs.me/#contact)
Language: English

## Services

- Software: AI products, apps and internal tools. Lately, mostly AI.
- Web: websites with a bit of life in them, like rzlabs.me.
- Motion: product videos, UI animation and motion design.
- Animation: characters, loops and short animated pieces.

## Selected work

- [ObraXRAY](https://obraxray.com): checks Portuguese construction companies against official public records before you sign. Fábio is CTO & co-founder and built the product.
- [TheCattleyaStudio](https://bycattleyastudio.com): swimwear brand. Fábio is co-founder and built the tech behind it.
- [KeybindStudios](https://keybindstudios.com): animation studio. Fábio is co-founder (product, animation and a bit of everything else) and built keybindstudios.com.
- [Hypnotic](https://hypnoticagency.com): Fábio has been a full stack developer there for the past few years.

## About the site

rzlabs.me is built with Astro, GSAP and Lenis and hosted on Vercel. The three cats roam the page, take the project brief in a chat, and record a short replay of your visit.
